title: ADC 2000 electronic defrost test mode entry
description: Enter ADC defrost test — bi-metal must be closed. Heater runs up to 18 min or until bi-metal opens.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool WRT311 ADC 2000 Wiring Sheet (W10674984 Rev A)

steps.title: Enter ADC defrost test mode
steps.body: Bi-metal must be closed. Option 1: power off 30 s → thermostat OFF → power on. Option 2: thermostat OFF 15 s → ON 5 s (×3) → OFF. Relay click confirms entry. Heater runs up to 18 minutes or until bi-metal opens. Do not bypass bi-metal — risk of overheating evaporator.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electronic defrost control test mode — W10674984 page 1.
